beats.summary: Jim reveals that Pam went on two dates with Danny before he and Pam started dating.

evidence.snippet: Jim: So four years ago, when I was in Stamford, Connecticut, and dating someone else, Pam went on two dates with Danny.

beats.summary: Jim and Pam ask their coworkers not to attend Danny's Halloween party due to their awkward history.

evidence.snippet: Andy: I'm really sorry, but we can't come to your party tonight.

beats.summary: Michael is upset that Darryl went over his head to corporate with the sales idea.

evidence.snippet: Michael: No, he didn't go behind my back. He went over my head.
